info.title: Cogmento CRM Universal API
info.description: Cogmento CRM is a customer relationship management platform for managing contacts, deals, tasks, products, and account templates through the Cogmento API.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

channels[].description: Contact channels array, such as email or phone channel objects.

doNotCall.description: Set true to mark the contact as do not call.

doNotText.description: Set true to mark the contact as do not text.

doNotEmail.description: Set true to mark the contact as do not email.

products[].description: Array of product reference objects associated with the deal.
